sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates the current-momentum signal: coding agents, agent skills, workflow automation, and web/data tooling account for most of the standout repositories. GitHub's daily Trending page was empty at collection time, so this is an API-backed proxy rather than a verified star-gain ranking.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic development dominates. Workflow platforms, web context, RAG, and reusable skills form the surrounding stack. TypeScript leads the listed set with 6 repositories; Python follows with 3, and Shell accounts for 1.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The visible shift is from standalone model libraries toward operational agent systems: skills, harnesses, coding interfaces, workflow orchestration, and context acquisition.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's corroborated momentum is concentrated in the agent stack rather than in a single model release. Treat the ordering as directional because GitHub Trending exposed no entries at collection time and the API does not provide daily star gains.
